missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Карман' is a masculine noun in the nominative as the subject. 'Пустой' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'этот' points to a specific pocket.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Карман' is accusative after 'в', marking motion into the pocket. The inanimate masculine keeps the nominative form.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В кармане' uses the prepositional form 'кармане' after 'в' to show where the keys are. The masculine ending is '-е'.
Strategic focus: Genitive of source. 'Кармана' is the genitive singular after 'из', marking motion out of the pocket. The masculine ending is '-а'.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Кармана' is the genitive singular after 'нет', marking absence. The masculine ending '-а' is required by the negation.
Strategic focus: Dative of attachment. 'Карману' is the dative singular after 'к', marking the point of attachment. The masculine ending '-у' is standard.

missions.phrase: Он играет с ключами в кармане.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В кармане' again uses the prepositional form 'кармане' after 'в'. 'С ключами' is instrumental, describing what he plays with.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Карман' is the accusative direct object of 'проверил'. As an inanimate masculine noun it keeps the nominative form. 'Каждый' agrees.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Карманы' is the nominative plural subject. 'Глубокие' agrees in the plural, describing the pockets of the trousers.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Карманы' is the accusative plural object of 'набили'. 'Конфетами' is instrumental, showing what the pockets were stuffed with.
